intro: Relative pronouns for careful Spanish: after prepositions, after commas, and whose.
p.el cual.nota: La cual, los cuales, las cuales.
p.cuyo.nota: Cuyo agrees with the thing owned, not with the owner: cuya, cuyos, cuyas.
b1.texto:
**After a preposition**, the relative needs an article: **el que, la que, los que, las que**. More formally, **el cual, la cual, los cuales, las cuales**. For people, also **quien, quienes**.

- la empresa **en la que** trabajo · la empresa **para la cual** trabajo
- el amigo **con quien** vivo · el amigo **con el que** vivo

**Between commas**, the clause only adds information, and que, quien or el cual are all possible: mi jefa, **que** / **quien** / **la cual** vive en Roma, viene mañana.

**Lo cual** and **lo que** pick up a whole idea: llegó tarde, **lo cual** me molestó.

**Cuyo** is whose. It agrees with the thing owned and takes no article: el autor **cuya** novela leí; los vecinos **cuyos** hijos conoces.

**Quien** with no noun before it means whoever: **quien** quiera venir, que venga.
b3.f0: The company I work for has won a prize.
b3.f1: Its director, who founded the company ten years ago, collected it yesterday.
b3.f2: She is a woman whose ideas have changed the sector.
b3.f3: She gave no speech, which surprised everyone.
b3.f4: The employees I spoke to were very proud.
b5.pregunta: Complete: the company I work for.
b5.o0.refuerzo: After para, the relative keeps its article.
b5.o1.refuerzo: After para the article is needed.
b5.o2.refuerzo: Lo que cannot refer to la empresa.
b6.pregunta: Complete: the author whose novels I read.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It agrees with the thing owned: novelas.
b7.pregunta: Complete: he arrived late, which annoyed me.
b7.o0.refuerzo: It refers to the whole idea.
b7.o1.refuerzo: El cual would need a masculine noun.
b8.pregunta: In «Mi jefa, que vive en Roma, viene mañana», what do the commas tell you?
b8.o1.refuerzo: That would be written without commas.
b8.o2.refuerzo: Commas do not make a question.
b9.pregunta: Complete: the friend I live with.
b9.o0.refuerzo: A person after a preposition: quien.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Lo que cannot refer to a person.
b10.traduccion: She is a woman whose ideas have changed the sector.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a formal description of a company or an institution using cuyo, el cual, en el que, quienes.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Describe aloud three people and three places with long relative clauses: la persona con la que…, el lugar en el que…
